summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a transaction in own shares as part of an existing share buyback programme. On 16 June 2026, the company purchased 2,632,073 ordinary shares from Goldman Sachs International at a volume-weighted average price of 103.6345 pence per share, with prices ranging from 102.7000 to 103.9000 pence. The programme was announced on 30 January 2026. Shares purchased will be cancelled. This ongoing capital return to shareholders is routine. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The filing reflects a standard open-market buyback execution; watch for further purchases as the programme continues.
